meta.title: Privacy Policy (GDPR) | CampusSphere
meta.description: CampusSphere privacy policy and data protection compliance: how we collect, use, and secure your personal data.
meta.ogDescription: Learn how CampusSphere protects your personal data and respects your privacy.

header.title: Privacy
header.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data across CampusSphere and Sphera.

s1.title: 1. Data Collection & Minimum Age
s1.intro: CampusSphere collects only the information necessary to operate the platform and support your studies:
s1.i1: Personal details: First name, last name, student or personal email address.
s1.i2: Minimum age requirement (16 years old): Registration is reserved for individuals aged 16 and older. For minors between 16 and 18, prior consent from a parent or legal guardian is required.
s1.i3: Academic profile: Educational institution, faculty, major, and study level.
s1.i4: User content: Posts, study summaries, comments, and shared academic documents.
s1.i5: Technical performance data: Anonymized rendering metrics via Vercel Speed Insights (with zero advertising profiling).

s2.title: 2. Data Usage & Unified Sphera Ecosystem
s2.intro: Your data is used exclusively to:
s2.i1: Provide, secure, and improve the features of the CampusSphere student social network.
s2.i2: Power the Sphera academic assistant through a unified Single Sign-On (SSO) account.
s2.i3: Allocate your revision credits and study passes, and synchronize your notes and study sessions.
s2.i4: Keep the community safe and moderate fraudulent or abusive behavior.

s3.title: 3. Cloud Subprocessors & Secure Infrastructure
s3.intro: We never sell or rent your personal data to third parties. Essential technical processing is performed by industry-leading partners providing strong encryption:
s3.b1Desc: Vercel Inc. — Secure TLS 1.3 content delivery and anonymized technical performance metrics.
s3.b2Desc: Amazon Web Services (AWS EC2) — Isolated hosting for APIs and application services.
s3.b3Desc: Supabase Inc. — Secure account management, sessions, and encrypted application data.
s3.b4Desc: Amazon Web Services (AWS S3) — Encrypted-at-rest (AES-256) storage for files and study materials.
s3.b5Desc: <b1>AWS Bedrock</b1>, complemented by <b2>Google AI (Gemini)</b2> and <b3>Groq Inc.</b3>, with zero public model training.
s3.b6Desc: Secure Campay payment gateway (MTN MoMo, Orange Money) with zero storage of secret PIN codes.

s4.title: 4. Artificial Intelligence Processing (Sphera)
s4.i1: Uploaded documents (PDFs, scanned lectures, notes) are analyzed solely to generate your revision sheets, quizzes, flashcards, or exam corrections.
s4.i2: Zero public training: Your personal documents are never reused to train general public AI models of our providers (AWS Bedrock, Google, Groq).
s4.i3: Your documents and sessions are stored on AWS S3 under your control and can be deleted anytime from your personal workspace.

s5.title: 5. Your Rights
s5.intro: You have the following rights regarding your personal data at any time:
s5.i3: Request permanent deletion of your account and data (see our <link>Data Deletion</link> page).
s5.i4: Export your data in a structured format.
s5.i5: Object to processing or withdraw your consent at any time.
s5.outro: To exercise these rights, contact us at <mail>policies@campussphere.app</mail>.

s6.title: 6. Security
s6.body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational safeguards (TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, AES-256 encryption at rest, strict access controls) to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

s7.title: 7. Contact & Data Protection Officer (DPO)
s7.intro: For any question regarding this Privacy Policy or to exercise your data rights:

meta.ogDescription: Review the Terms of Use and engagement rules on the CampusSphere student network.

header.title: Terms of
header.subtitle: The rules governing access to CampusSphere and Sphera to keep our student community reliable and respectful.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.body: By creating an account or browsing CampusSphere (and its Sphera AI study assistant), you unconditionally accept these Terms of Use. If you do not agree to these terms, you must stop using the platform immediately.

s2.title: 2. Registration, Minimum Age & Account
s2.i1: <b1>Minimum age requirement:</b1> Access to CampusSphere is strictly reserved for individuals aged at least <b2>16 years old</b2>. If you are between 16 and 18, you confirm that you have prior consent from your parents or legal guardians.
s2.i2: CampusSphere is primarily intended for students enrolled in higher education or upper secondary education.
s2.i3: You must provide a truthful identity and accurate information when registering.
s2.i4: You are solely responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials.
s2.i5: You must report any suspicious login or security breach to us without delay.
s2.i6: Creating automated or multiple fake accounts (bots, impersonation profiles) is strictly prohibited.

s3.title: 3. Use of the Platform & Sphera AI Assistant
s3.i1: Use the platform lawfully, respectfully, and in compliance with Cameroonian and international laws.
s3.i2: Strictly respect the intellectual property rights of authors, lecturers, and third parties.
s3.i3: Refrain from posting abusive, defamatory, violent, or unlawful content.
s3.i4: Never use our services to cheat during official examinations.
s3.i5: Never attempt to tamper with servers or scrape data without authorization.
s3.spheraNote: CampusSphere also integrates the Sphera AI study assistant (powered by AWS Bedrock, Google AI, and Groq). Uploaded documents are processed exclusively to generate your revision sheets, flashcards, and quizzes, and are never used to train public AI models.

s4.title: 4. User Content & Technical Hosting License
s4.intro: Regarding documents, summaries, and posts you share:
s4.i1: Ownership preserved: You retain full intellectual property ownership of your original content and documents.
s4.i2: Technical license: To enable us to operate the service, you grant CampusSphere a worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive license to host, store on our secure servers (Amazon Web Services S3), technically replicate, index, and display your content solely for operating the community and Sphera assistant.
s4.i3: Lawfulness warranty: You confirm that you hold the necessary rights or permissions for any materials you upload.
s4.i4: CampusSphere reserves the right to moderate or remove without prior notice any content violating applicable laws or Community Guidelines.

s5.title: 5. Paid Services, Subscriptions & Mobile Money Payments
s5.intro: Access to certain advanced features (extended Sphera AI credits, Exam Passes, premium packs) may be billed in CFA Francs (XAF).
s5.i1: Payments are processed via Mobile Money (MTN MoMo, Orange Money) through approved encrypted payment gateways.
s5.i2: Order terms, immediate digital service execution, and cancellation policies are detailed in our <link>Terms of Sale</link>.

s6.title: 6. Prohibited Conduct
s6.intro: The following behaviors are strictly prohibited:
s6.i3: Sharing violent or sexually explicit content.
s6.i6: Use of bots or abusive automation.

s7.title: 7. Intellectual Property
s7.body: CampusSphere and its original content are protected by copyright, trademark, and intellectual property laws. You may not copy, modify, or distribute our proprietary content without prior written authorization.

s8.title: 8. Limitation of Liability, Termination & Updates
s8.p1: Availability: CampusSphere is provided “as is”. We make every effort to ensure service continuity without guaranteeing uninterrupted or error-free operation.
s8.p2: Termination: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account in the event of a breach of these terms. You may also delete your account anytime from your settings.
s8.p3: Updates: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be notified to you by email or directly on the platform.

s9.title: 9. Contact
s9.intro: For any question regarding these Terms of Use, please contact:

meta.ogDescription: Purchase terms, subscriptions, and Mobile Money payments via Campay on CampusSphere.

header.title: Terms of
header.subtitle: Pricing in XAF, Sphera study passes and AI credits, and secure Mobile Money payments via the Campay API.

s1.title: 1. Scope & Purpose
s1.p1: These Terms of Sale govern all purchases of digital services, subscriptions, and artificial intelligence credits offered by <b1>CampusSphere</b1> and its companion service <b2>Sphera</b2> without restriction or reservation.
s1.p2: Any paid purchase implies full acceptance of these Terms of Sale and our Terms of Use. Users confirm they are at least 16 years old and possess legal capacity (or guardian consent) to enter into a contract.

s2.title: 2. Services Offered, Plans & Pricing
s2.p1: CampusSphere offers digital academic assistance services, including generation of revision sheets, quizzes, flashcards, exam corrections, and priority access to Sphera AI models.
s2.i1: Beta Phase: During open beta or testing periods, services may be provided free of charge (0 XAF) subject to fair-usage quotas.
s2.i2: One-Time Passes (e.g., Exam Pass): Fixed-duration access (7 days, 30 days, etc.) with no auto-renewal. The pass expires at the end of its period with no recurring charge.
s2.i3: Recurring Subscriptions: Continuous access with periodic renewal that can be canceled anytime from account settings.
s2.p2: All prices are stated in CFA Francs (XAF) inclusive of all taxes. CampusSphere reserves the right to adjust pricing at any time; the applicable amount is always the one displayed at checkout confirmation.

s3.title: 3. Secure Payment Methods (Mobile Money via Campay)
s3.p1: To deliver a smooth payment experience tailored to local realities, Mobile Money transactions are processed through the certified payment aggregator Campay (Campay API).
s3.i1: MTN Mobile Money: Direct checkout with USSD prompt and confirmation on the student’s phone.
s3.i2: Orange Money: Secure authorization via approval code or mobile confirmation.
s3.p2: The Campay API ensures end-to-end encrypted transaction security. CampusSphere never collects, views, or stores any PIN code or banking password.

s4.title: 4. Immediate Execution & Right of Withdrawal
s4.p1: Purchased services consist of digital content not supplied on a physical medium and AI study assistance whose execution begins immediately upon payment confirmation.
s4.callout: By confirming your Mobile Money transaction via Campay, you expressly request immediate activation of paid features and acknowledge waiving your right of withdrawal once service execution has begun or AI credits have been consumed.

s5.title: 5. Refund Policy & Claims
s5.p1: No retroactive refund is granted for elapsed periods, expired passes, or already consumed AI generations.
s5.p2: In the event of a verified technical error (e.g., duplicate Mobile Money charge, account debited without feature activation within 2 hours), the user must contact support immediately with their Campay transaction reference:
s5.i2: Processing time: Response and resolution within 24 to 48 business hours.

s6.title: 6. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
s6.p1: These Terms of Sale are governed by the laws of Cameroon and e-commerce regulations applicable within the CEMAC zone.
s6.p2: In the event of a dispute, an amicable settlement will be sought first. Failing an amicable resolution within thirty (30) days, any dispute shall be referred to the competent courts of Douala, Cameroon.

meta.title: Account & Data Deletion | CampusSphere
meta.description: Learn how to permanently delete your account and personal data from CampusSphere and Sphera.
meta.ogDescription: Step-by-step instructions to exercise your right to erasure on CampusSphere.

header.title: Data
header.subtitle: Stay in control of your personal data and follow the steps to permanently delete your CampusSphere and Sphera account.

s1.title: 1. Your Right to Erasure
s1.p1: In accordance with Cameroonian legislation (Law No. 2010/012 on Cybersecurity) and international privacy standards (GDPR), every student or user registered on CampusSphere and Sphera holds a fundamental right to complete erasure of their personal data (“right to be forgotten”).
s1.p2: You may exercise this right at any time, independently and free of charge.

s2.title: 2. How to Delete Your Account
s2.intro: To initiate immediate and irreversible deletion of your account:
s2.step1: Sign in to your account at campussphere.app.
s2.step2: Open <b1>Settings</b1> (gear icon), then go to <b2>Account & Security</b2>.
s2.step3: Select Delete my account at the bottom of the page.
s2.step4: Confirm the action by entering your account password.
s2.callout: If you are unable to log in, send an email request to <mail>policies@campussphere.app</mail> from the email address linked to your account. Our team will process the full purge within 48 hours.

s3.title: 3. Data Permanently Deleted
s3.intro: Confirming deletion results in immediate and irreversible removal of:
s3.i1: Your profile (first name, last name, photo, status, institution, and major).
s3.i2: Your authentication credentials and active sessions on CampusSphere and Sphera (Supabase).
s3.i3: Your posts, comments, ratings, and private messages.
s3.i4: Your uploaded documents, generated revision sheets, quizzes, and flashcards hosted on AWS S3.
s3.i5: Your academic Sphere memberships and connections.

s4.title: 4. Backups & Residual Retention Periods
s4.intro: Removal from the live database is instantaneous. For strict service continuity and security requirements:
s4.i1: Encrypted system backups: Global system backups are cyclically purged within a maximum of 30 days, after which no residual data remains.
s4.i2: Legal & Campay financial records: Financial proof records (Mobile Money transaction references) are archived only within the limits and periods required by applicable tax and banking regulations.

s5.title: 5. Contact & Support
s5.intro: For any question about data processing or account deletion:

header.title: Community
header.subtitle: Simple principles keeping every Sphere healthy, welcoming, and genuinely helpful for students.

s1.title: 1. Respect and Kindness
s1.i1: Treat every member with respect and courtesy.
s1.i2: Value diversity of viewpoints, majors, and backgrounds.
s1.i3: Encourage and support your peers in their projects and exam prep.

s2.title: 2. Safety and Protection
s2.i1: Never share sensitive personal data (phone numbers, passwords, private IDs).
s2.i2: Report any inappropriate, abusive, or suspicious behavior.
s2.i3: Protect your own privacy as well as that of fellow members.
s2.i4: Never use the platform for harassment or intimidation.

s3.title: 3. Prohibited Content
s3.intro: The following content is strictly prohibited on CampusSphere:
s3.i4: Spam, scams, or unauthorized commercial solicitation.

s4.title: 4. Collaboration and Sharing
s4.i1: Share clear, useful academic resources with your classmates.
s4.i2: Always credit your sources when sharing study materials or work.
s4.i3: Contribute actively and positively inside collaborative Spheres.
s4.i4: Respect the intellectual work of fellow students and lecturers.

s5.title: 5. Consequences of Violations
s5.intro: Depending on severity, violating these rules may result in:
s5.i1: A formal warning from our moderation team.
s5.i4: Permanent ban in severe or repeated cases.

s6.title: 6. Report an Issue
s6.intro: If you witness a violation of these guidelines, report it promptly:
s6.i1: Using the “Report” button available on every post and resource.

s7.title: 7. Contact
s7.intro: For any question regarding our Community Guidelines:

meta.title: Cookie & Tracker Policy | CampusSphere
meta.description: Information on technical, session, and anonymized performance cookies used on CampusSphere.
meta.ogDescription: How CampusSphere uses strictly essential cookies with zero advertising tracking.

header.title: Cookie
header.subtitle: How we rely solely on essential technical trackers, with zero advertising profiling.

s1.title: 1. What Is a Cookie?
s1.body: A cookie is a small text file or technical storage entry placed on your device when visiting CampusSphere. It ensures core platform functionality, keeps your session securely logged in, and optimizes browsing performance.

s2.title: 2. Types of Trackers and Cookies Used
s2.b1Desc: Essential for the platform to work: keeping your authentication session secure and remembering your core preferences (such as language).
s2.b2Desc: Anonymized page load and responsiveness metrics. No commercial profiling cookies, no personally identifiable data, and no cross-site tracking.
s2.callout: Zero third-party ad targeting cookies: CampusSphere strictly rejects intrusive advertising trackers (no Google AdSense, no Meta/Facebook Pixel, and no third-party ad monetization networks).

s3.title: 3. Managing Cookies
s3.p1: You can configure your browser at any time to block or delete cookies. Please note that disabling strictly necessary cookies will prevent you from signing in to your CampusSphere account.
s3.p2: To adjust your preferences, open the privacy settings in your web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).

s4.title: 4. Contact
s4.intro: For any question regarding cookies and trackers on CampusSphere:

meta.description: Read CampusSphere’s copyright policy, intellectual property standards, and takedown reporting procedures.
meta.ogDescription: Author protection, intellectual property compliance, and content reporting on CampusSphere.

header.title: Copyright
header.subtitle: How we protect copyright holders and handle takedown notifications on CampusSphere.

s1.title: 1. Respect for Intellectual Property
s1.body: CampusSphere respects the intellectual property rights of others and expects its users to do the same. We respond to notices of alleged copyright infringement in accordance with applicable Cameroonian law — notably Law No. 2010/012 on Cybersecurity and Cybercrime and Law No. 2000/011 on Copyright — as well as OAPI (African Intellectual Property Organization) rules.

s2.title: 2. Reporting an Infringement
s2.intro: If you believe your copyrighted work has been reproduced or shared without authorization, please provide the following information:
s2.i1: Electronic or physical signature of the rights holder.
s2.i2: Clear description of the copyrighted work allegedly infringed.
s2.i3: Exact URL or location of the disputed material on CampusSphere.
s2.i4: Your complete contact details (name, address, phone number, email).
s2.i5: A good-faith statement confirming the disputed use is not authorized.
s2.i6: A sworn statement certifying the accuracy of the information provided.

s3.title: 3. Notification Procedure
s3.intro: Send your infringement notice to our legal team:

s4.title: 4. Counter-Notification
s4.intro: If you believe your content was removed in error, you may submit a counter-notification containing:
s4.i2: Identification of the removed content and its prior location.
s4.i3: A sworn statement explaining why you believe the removal was made in error.
s4.i4: Your full name, address, and contact details.

s5.title: 5. Repeat Infringer Policy
s5.body: In accordance with applicable law, CampusSphere enforces a policy of suspending or terminating accounts belonging to users identified as repeat infringers.

s6.title: 6. User-Generated Content
s6.intro: By publishing content on CampusSphere, you:
s6.i1: Retain all ownership rights over your original content.
s6.i2: Grant CampusSphere a worldwide technical license to host, store, and display your content as part of the service.
s6.i3: Warrant that you hold the necessary rights over any shared materials.
s6.i4: Agree that CampusSphere may remove any content reported as infringing third-party copyrights.

s7.title: 7. Contact
s7.intro: For any question regarding our Copyright Policy:
